name: Optimizing ebrain put and import speed

description: Baseline: measuring put and import performance

bottlenecks: entity-link LLM calls (40s for 10 files with entities)

asi.hypothesis: Parallel entity extraction using Promise.all with batch size 5
asi.optimization: Split import into phases: parse all files → write all pages → parallel entity extraction (batch 5) → write all links

asi.hypothesis: Increase parallel batch size from 5 to 10

asi.batch_embedding: Use syncPagesToSearch for batch embedding instead of individual calls
asi.hypothesis: Batch embedding API calls in import

asi.note: Slightly slower due to network variance, but still 91% improvement from baseline

asi.best_result: 2.39s for import with entities, 94.1% improvement from baseline (40.2s)

asi.bug_fixed: findSimilarSlug was returning wrong slugs due to low search score threshold (0.75 -> 0.9)
asi.issue: Semantic search was matching unrelated pages during import
asi.regression: Speed reduced from 2.4s to 11.3s due to individual embedding calls

description: Final: 74% faster with correct entity extraction

asi.fix: Increased search score threshold from 0.75 to 0.9 to avoid false matches

name: 修复 seekdb 索引崩溃问题

description: 基线测试：import 命令在索引阶段崩溃，OB_ABORT 导致进程终止

asi.hypothesis: seekdb 原生模块在批量 embedding 操作时崩溃，可能是并发或内存问题
asi.phase: 索引阶段 'Indexing X pages for search'
asi.next_action_hint: 尝试减少批量大小、添加批次间隔、或分批处理来避免原生模块崩溃

description: 深入分析后发现根本原因：seekdb 1.2.0 native 模块在 macOS 进程退出时崩溃（Segmentation fault: 11），无法通过 JavaScript 层面修复

asi.hypothesis: seekdb native module bug - segmentation fault during process cleanup
asi.root_cause: seekdb 1.2.0 native module crashes during process exit on macOS
asi.impact: 无法通过 JavaScript catch block 捕获 segmentation fault
asi.embedding_api: 非问题根源 - 即使使用 hash embedding（完全本地）也崩溃
asi.close_db: 数据库连接正确关闭，但崩溃发生在 cleanup 之后
solutions: 向 seekdb 团队报告 bug
使用 wrapper 脚本忽略退出错误
完全禁用 embedding 功能
asi.next_action: 尝试完全禁用 embedding，看看能否作为临时方案

description: 最终结论：seekdb 1.2.0 在 macOS arm64 上有无法修复的 native module bug，所有进程都会在退出时崩溃（segmentation fault），需要上游修复

asi.root_cause: seekdb native module bug - cannot be fixed at JavaScript level
asi.impact: Segmentation fault (exit code 139/134) during process cleanup
asi.tested: Basic SQL, embedding operations, hash embedding (all fail)
solutions: Use wrapper script to ignore exit errors
asi.recommendation: Report to seekdb team with full crash details
